annotations.title: Check QRIS Payment Status & Credit Ledger

description: Check QRIS top-up order payment status (PENDING or PAID), current workspace credit balance, credit mutation ledger history, and official downloadable PDF invoice URLs. Use this tool to verify whether an order from create_qris_invoice has settled or to audit credit consumption; do not use it to generate a new payment invoice (use create_qris_invoice instead) or view campaign click rates (use get_campaign_analytics instead). Read-only operation requiring PUSHNOTIF_API_KEY with 0 credit cost; pass order_id to inspect a single invoice or omit it to list recent orders and ledger entries. Returns JSON { credits_balance, orders: [{ id, amount_rp, credits_added, status, invoice_pdf_url, created_at }], recent_ledger: [{ id, delta, reason, created_at }] }.

order_id.description: Optional specific QRIS order ID in format ord_xxxx (from create_qris_invoice) to check; omit to return the latest orders and ledger history

name: check_billing_and_qris_status
